rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken choice for a collection containing many different kinds of things.

example.english: This shop has a diverse range of stationery.
example.traditional: 呢間店有各式各樣嘅文具。
example.jyutping: nei1 gaan1 dim3 jau5 gok3 sik1 gok3 joeng6 ge3 man4 geoi6

rows.note: Use this for a community or organization whose membership includes people from varied demographic backgrounds.

example.english: This community is very diverse, with people from all kinds of backgrounds.
example.traditional: 呢個社區好多元化，唔同背景嘅人都有。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 se5 keoi1 hou2 do1 jyun4 faa3 m4 tung4 bui3 ging2 ge3 jan4 dou1 jau5
